text: Welcome.
You made it to the end of this day.
Let your eyes close, if they haven't already.
Take one breath in, as deep as feels good.
Let it pour out of you, slow and heavy.
Feel the weight of your body on the bed.
You're not floating tonight.
You're sinking, and that's exactly right.
Your shoulders can melt downward, away from your ears.
Your jaw can soften, teeth coming apart slightly.
There's nothing left to grip, nothing left to hold.
Your hands are done for the day.
Feel your breath getting slower, on its own.
You've done enough today.
You've done enough this week.
You've done enough.
There's nothing left on the list tonight.
Your body is allowed to be heavy now.
Let your legs go heavy, hip to heel.
Your whole body is sinking into the mattress.
The mattress is holding all of your weight.
Your mind is getting quieter, like a room settling.
Whatever's left is far away now, and that's fine.
There's nowhere you need to be but here.
If sleep comes, let it come.
And if it's just rest, that's enough too.
You can drift from here.
